message:
## Vulnerability Digest

Nine relevant vulnerability records were newly published or materially updated during this scan window. The highest-priority items are the Ubuntu Brotli and nginx memory-safety issues, which carry critical CVSS v4 base scores, and the high-severity MongoDB Shell certificate-trust issue.

**Scope:** `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` only, combined with obvious aliases normalized and duplicate products removed. `DLL_software_component.txt` was not read or combined.

**Scan window:** 2026-10-26 05:10 IST through 2026-10-27 05:10 IST (2026-10-25 23:40 UTC through 2026-10-26 23:40 UTC).

### Findings

**1. MongoDB Shell (mongosh) — CVE-2026-115930**
- **Severity:** High (CVSS 7.6 in the published CVE record)
- **Description:** `mongosh` before 2.14.0 bundles a Node.js TLS root store containing recoverable eMudhra intermediate CA certificates, creating a risk of TLS man-in-the-middle certificate acceptance.
- **Relevance:** MongoDB is monitored, and `mongosh` is an official MongoDB component included in the required ecosystem sweep.
- **Source:** [MongoDB mongosh 2.14.0 release notes](https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongodb-shell/changelog/)

**2. Ubuntu Brotli package — CVE-2026-111497**
- **Severity:** Critical, CVSS v4.0 9.2; Ubuntu priority Medium
- **Description:** Crafted Brotli-compressed input can corrupt decoder memory, disclose memory, crash the process, or potentially execute code.
- **Relevance:** Ubuntu is monitored. Canonical published USN-8956-1 on October 26 with fixed packages for Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, 24.04 LTS, 26.04 LTS, and 26.10.
- **Source:** [Ubuntu USN-8956-1](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8956-1)

**3. nginx alias/rewrite handling — CVE-2026-15176**
- **Severity:** Critical, CVSS v4.0 9.2; Ubuntu priority Medium
- **Description:** Certain `alias`, rewrite, and `$request_filename` configurations can permit crafted requests to trigger a heap overflow, denial of service, or possible code execution.
- **Relevance:** Both nginx and Ubuntu are monitored. Canonical published fixed nginx packages on October 26.
- **Source:** [Ubuntu CVE-2026-15176 record](https://ubuntu.com/security/CVE-2026-15176)

**4. nginx map-regex handling — CVE-2026-93479**
- **Severity:** Critical, CVSS v4.0 9.2; Ubuntu priority Medium
- **Description:** Certain regex capture-variable uses in nginx `map` configurations can trigger a heap overflow, denial of service, or possible code execution.
- **Relevance:** Both nginx and Ubuntu are monitored, and Canonical updated this record and published fixed packages during the window.
- **Source:** [Ubuntu CVE-2026-93479 record](https://ubuntu.com/security/CVE-2026-93479)

**5. nginx HTTP/3 request injection — CVE-2026-95101**
- **Severity:** Medium, CVSS v3.1 5.3
- **Description:** nginx HTTP/3 deployments using `proxy_request_buffering on` may allow an unauthenticated attacker to inject data into proxied requests.
- **Relevance:** Both nginx and Ubuntu are monitored; Canonical states this affects Ubuntu 26.04 LTS and 26.10 and published fixes on October 26.
- **Source:** [Ubuntu USN-8955-1](https://ubuntu.com/security/notices/USN-8955-1)

**6. nginx asynchronous I/O use-after-free — CVE-2026-97205**
- **Severity:** Critical, CVSS v4.0 9.2; Ubuntu priority Medium
- **Description:** Specific nginx AIO and Server Side Includes configurations can cause a worker-process use-after-free, memory corruption, denial of service, or possible code execution.
- **Relevance:** Both nginx and Ubuntu are monitored, and Canonical updated this record and published fixed packages during the window.
- **Source:** [Ubuntu CVE-2026-97205 record](https://ubuntu.com/security/CVE-2026-97205)

**7. nginx SSL session-ticket verification bypass — CVE-2026-97629**
- **Severity:** High, CVSS v4.0 8.3; Ubuntu priority Medium
- **Description:** Certain shared SSL session-cache configurations without explicit ticket-key rotation can allow forged client sessions and possible client-certificate verification bypass.
- **Relevance:** Both nginx and Ubuntu are monitored. Canonical published fixes for Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, 26.04 LTS, and 26.10 on October 26.
- **Source:** [Ubuntu CVE-2026-97629 record](https://ubuntu.com/security/CVE-2026-97629)

**8. Firefox for iOS FaceTime prompt spoofing — CVE-2026-116632**
- **Severity:** Moderate (Mozilla)
- **Description:** A malicious page can place attacker-controlled text in the iOS FaceTime call prompt, enabling phishing content to appear inside system UI.
- **Relevance:** Mozilla Firefox is monitored; the affected mobile edition is part of that product family.
- **Source:** [Mozilla MFSA 2026-117](https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/mfsa2026-117/)

**9. Firefox for iOS telephone prompt spoofing — CVE-2026-116631**
- **Severity:** Low (Mozilla)
- **Description:** A malicious page can open a telephone link while displaying another site, making the phone-call prompt appear to originate from that site.
- **Relevance:** Mozilla Firefox is monitored; the affected mobile edition is part of that product family.
- **Source:** [Mozilla MFSA 2026-117](https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/security/advisories/mfsa2026-117/)

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, drivers, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations and maintained libraries, MongoDB alerts, CVE/NVD records, GitHub advisories, CISA-related records, and credible CERT reporting.

CVE-2026-115930 is the only newly published MongoDB-family finding verified inside the window. MongoDB Compass and C/C#/PHP driver advisories dated October 22–24, and Ops Manager records published October 9, were excluded as stale. CVE-2026-116165 affects the independent Parse Server application when backed by MongoDB, not MongoDB itself, so it was excluded as a loose product match.

### Review priority

Immediate review is recommended for affected Ubuntu/nginx deployments and for `mongosh` versions before 2.14.0. Firefox for iOS should be updated to 156.1 where deployed.
